description: This file defines the AutorouteEntries class, which manages autoroute entries and their synchronization with the index in OrchardCore CMS. It handles caching, initialization, updates, and refreshes of autoroute data, interacting with the database and document management system.

classes.name: AutorouteEntries
classes.description: Manages autoroute entries, including caching, initialization, and synchronization with the index, providing methods to retrieve, update, and refresh autoroute data.

methods.name: TryGetEntryByPathAsync
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve an autoroute entry by its path asynchronously.

methods.name: TryGetEntryByContentItemIdAsync
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve an autoroute entry by its content item ID asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateEntriesAsync
methods.description: Updates the autoroute entries cache based on the latest index state.

methods.name: EnsureInitializedAsync
methods.description: Ensures the autoroute entries are initialized and up-to-date.

methods.name: AddEntries
methods.description: Adds a collection of autoroute entries to the cache, evicting related entries as needed.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes a collection of autoroute entries from the cache.

methods.name: RefreshEntriesAsync
methods.description: Refreshes the cache of autoroute entries based on the current index state.

methods.name: InitializeEntriesAsync
methods.description: Initializes the autoroute entries cache from the index.
